title: The Secret Doctrine, Vol. 1
author: H. P. Blavatsky
description: The Secret Doctrine: The Synthesis of Science, Religion and Philosophy, Volume 1 (Cosmogenesis), by H. P. Blavatsky (first published London, 1888), here in the edition divided into separate volumes. The founding scripture of modern Theosophy, it presents commentaries on the 'Stanzas of Dzyan', which Blavatsky claimed to derive from an ancient secret text. After the Proem setting out the three fundamental propositions (an omnipresent, eternal, boundless principle; the periodicity of universal cycles; and the fundamental identity of all souls with the Over-Soul and their obligatory pilgrimage through the cycle of incarnation), it describes the emergence of the cosmos from the dark, undifferentiated Absolute, the awakening of the universe, the differentiation of the elements and planes, the hierarchies of Dhyan Chohans, the planetary chains and rounds. It supports its claims with references to Hindu, Buddhist, Kabbalistic, Hermetic, Egyptian and Greek sources and critiques of contemporary science.
